stem.text: What is the cause of symptoms of people with myasthenia gravis?

A.text: antibodies block receptor molecules on the cell surface membrane of muscle cells

B.text: it is an autoimmune disease where self-antigens attack antibodies

C.text: the destruction of T-lymphocytes, which have receptors complementary to self-antigens

D.text: the loss of cell surface membrane receptors in nerve cells found in the spinal cord
